description: What TraderSwift is for, and where to go next.
order: 28
part: The network, and where it stands
---

TraderSwift is the infrastructure layer for agentic trading.

It is built to secure what can sink a trader: the key, the channel agents talk on, and the trade logs.

It makes data and signals something you can check, not something you take on trust.

It gives you your own tools, which no company holds, and an AI that can learn from them only with your permission. Builders and founders can add to all of it, and builders are paid directly.

## What is running today?

Signer, the hub, our charts data node and Signals Desk are **Live**.

Everything else is built or planned, and [chapter 26](26-what-is-running-today-and-what-is-coming.html) says which, with dates.

## Where should I start?

- **To see it work** – read the [Signer how-tos](../signer-guides/index.html).
- **To see how we got here** – read [Since Lockbox](../since-lockbox/index.html).
- **To check it yourself** – read the code, or run the public charts node from [chapter 14](14-how-can-i-check-market-data.html).
- **To build a part of it** – read [chapter 25](25-can-i-build-a-subnet-of-my-own.html).

This update changes as each part goes live.
